name: agentic-soc
description: Governor Agent for orchestrating security investigations in an Agentic SOC using NIST framework and a local database.

hooks.name: mcp-telemetry
hooks.description: Logs metadata for every MCP tool execution.

hooks.name: token-telemetry
hooks.description: Logs token usage metadata for every model response.

settings.name: Storage Provider
settings.description: The local storage backend for investigation state (native, sqlite, or dolt).

settings.name: Dolt Binary Path
settings.description: The path to the Dolt binary (Optional: Only required if Storage Provider is set to 'dolt').

settings.name: Google Cloud Project ID
settings.description: The GCP Project ID where SecOps and Logging are located.

settings.name: SecOps Customer ID
settings.description: The UUID of your Google SecOps customer.

settings.name: Analyst Email
settings.description: Your official email address for case assignment and auditing.

settings.name: Timeline Data Table Name
settings.description: The name of the SecOps Data Table for investigation timelines.

settings.name: IOC Data Table Name
settings.description: The name of the SecOps Data Table for malicious IOCs.

settings.name: Detection Tuning Data Table Name
settings.description: The name of the SecOps Data Table for drafted YARA-L rules.
